scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs -- sh -c 'cd backend && go run .'
scripts.dev:backend:db: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs -- sh -c 'DB_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-${SCRM_DATABASE_URL:-postgres://scrm:scrm@127.0.0.1:15432/scrm_dev?sslmode=disable}}"; cd backend && SCRM_DATABASE_URL="$DB_URL" SCRM_AUTO_MIGRATE=true go run .'
scripts.dev:backend:db:redis: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs -- sh -c 'DB_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-${SCRM_DATABASE_URL:-postgres://scrm:scrm@127.0.0.1:15432/scrm_dev?sslmode=disable}}"; cd backend && SCRM_DATABASE_URL="$DB_URL" SCRM_REDIS_ADDR="${SCRM_REDIS_ADDR:-127.0.0.1:16379}" SCRM_AUTO_MIGRATE=true go run .'
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs -- sh -c 'DB_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-${SCRM_DATABASE_URL:-postgres://scrm:scrm@127.0.0.1:15432/scrm_dev?sslmode=disable}}"; cd backend && go run ./cmd/scrm-admin migrate --database-url "$DB_URL"'
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs -- sh -c 'DB_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-${SCRM_DATABASE_URL:-postgres://scrm:scrm@127.0.0.1:15432/scrm_dev?sslmode=disable}}"; cd backend && go run ./cmd/scrm-admin seed --database-url "$DB_URL" --seed seeds/customer_ops_demo_seed.sql'
scripts.db:status: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs -- sh -c 'DB_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-${SCRM_DATABASE_URL:-postgres://scrm:scrm@127.0.0.1:15432/scrm_dev?sslmode=disable}}"; cd backend && go run ./cmd/scrm-admin status --database-url "$DB_URL"'
scripts.test:backend:db: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs -- sh -c 'if [ -z "$SCRM_TEST_DATABASE_URL" ]; then echo "SCRM_TEST_DATABASE_URL is required; use a temporary PostgreSQL test database" >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$SCRM_TEST_DATABASE_URL" in *:15432/*) echo "refusing SCRM_TEST_DATABASE_URL on port 15432" >&2; exit 2;; esac; cd backend && go test ./...'
scripts.check: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && go test ./...
